description: This PHP file defines the 'Article' model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to create, read, update, and delete articles, their descriptions, stores, layouts, comments, and ratings in the database. The class handles complex operations such as adding descriptions in multiple languages, managing SEO URLs, and caching results.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Model class for managing articles within the Opencart CMS module, including CRUD operations, descriptions, store associations, layouts, comments, and ratings.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Creates a new article record in the database, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article record and associated information such as descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specified article.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Deletes an article and all related data like descriptions, store links, comments, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific article's data, including description in the current language.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of articles with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for an article in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific article.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for an article across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for an article.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with an article.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an article for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations from an article.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes layout associations by layout ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Fetches all layout associations for an article.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the number of layout associations for a layout ID.

methods.name: editCommentStatus
methods.description: Updates the approval status of an article comment.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific article comment.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment.

methods.name: deleteCommentsByArticleId
methods.description: Deletes all comments associated with an article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Fetches a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating distribution for an article, optionally filtered by comment.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments with filtering options such as keyword, article name, customer, status, and date range.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total number of comments matching the filters.
